sv.title: ”Anderssons sista strid”
sv.summary: Under hela valrörelsen undvek Magdalena Andersson att berätta hur hon tänkte bilda regering. Nu får hon betala priset – och det priset kan bli högt om regeringsmakten glider henne ur händerna. Det som nu utspelar sig kan bli Anderssons sista strid.

en.title: “Andersson's last battle”
en.summary: Throughout the election campaign, Magdalena Andersson avoided saying how she intended to form a government. Now she has to pay the price, and that price could be high if government power slips out of her hands. What is now unfolding could become Andersson's last battle.
